tool.name: pyrho make_table
tool.description: Build a demography-specific two-locus likelihood lookup table
tool.command: pyrho make_table @DEMOGRAPHY@ -n $samplesize -m $mu #if $approx: --approx #if str($moran_pop_size): -N $moran_pop_size #end if #end if -T $theta @THREADS@ #if $store_stationary: -S #end if #if $load_stationary: -L #end if #if str($decimate_rel_tol): --decimate_rel_tol $decimate_rel_tol #end if #if str($decimate_anc_size): --decimate_anc_size $decimate_anc_size #end if #if $high_accuracy_stationary: --high_accuracy_stationary #end if -o '$outfile'

param.name: samplesize
param.label: Sample size (number of haplotypes)
param.help: The maximum number of haplotypes for which the lookup table will be valid. Must be at least as large as the number of haplotypes in the data used downstream.

param.name: approx
param.label: Use approximate lookup table
param.help: Use the approximate (Moran model) lookup table. Recommended for sample sizes greater than about 20.

param.name: moran_pop_size
param.label: Moran population size (N)
param.help: Population size for the approximate Moran model. Only used with --approx. Should be about 25-50% larger than the sample size.

param.name: theta
param.label: Theta
param.help: The population-scaled mutation rate used to build the table.

param.name: store_stationary
param.label: Store stationary distribution
param.help: Store the stationary distribution in the lookup table.

param.name: load_stationary
param.label: Load stationary distribution
param.help: Load a previously stored stationary distribution.

param.name: decimate_rel_tol
param.label: Decimation relative tolerance
param.help: Relative tolerance when decimating the size history. Larger values smooth out small changes in population sizes and speed up computation.

param.name: decimate_anc_size
param.label: Most ancestral size when decimating
param.help: Most ancestral population size to use when decimating the size history.

param.name: high_accuracy_stationary
param.label: High accuracy stationary distribution
param.help: Use a high-accuracy stationary distribution (slower but more accurate).

tool.help:
**What it does**
`pyrho make_table` precomputes a demography-specific two-locus likelihood lookup table (stored as an HDF5 file) that is required by the other pyrho commands (`hyperparam`, `optimize`, `compute_r2`). The table is built for a specific sample size, per-generation mutation rate, and demographic history.
**Inputs**
- **Sample size** — the maximum number of haplotypes for which the table will be valid. It must be at least as large as the number of haplotypes in the data used downstream. - **Per-generation mutation rate** — e.g. `1.25e-8`. - **Demographic history** — one of: - Population sizes (comma-delimited) with optional epoch times (generations). - An MSMC output file (`--msmc_file`). - A smc++ CSV file (`--smcpp_file`).
**Output**
An HDF5 lookup table (datatype `h5`) containing the two-locus sampling distribution under the specified demography.
**Notes**
- Building large tables is memory-intensive. For sample sizes greater than about 20, use `--approx`. A sample size of 210 with `--approx` requires roughly 20 GB of RAM. - `--moran_pop_size` (N) is only used with `--approx` and should be about 25-50% larger than the sample size. - The first run triggers a numba JIT compilation (~30 s).
